
```{r}
library("phyloseq")
library("ggplot2")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("patchwork")
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
df <- read_delim(here::here("data/tables","final_quality_Mex_Shotgun_Es.tsv"), 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)
head(df)
```


```{
df$Contamination <- as.numeric(df$Contamination)
df$Completeness <- as.numeric(df$Completeness)

# Filtrar en df1
df_filtrado <- df %>% filter(df$Completeness >= 90, df$Contamination <= 15)
```



```{r}
#Se guarda en un archivo en el df_filtrado
write_tsv(df_filtrado, here("data","filtered_quality_Mex_Shotgun_Es.tsv"))
#Se guarda en .txt los IDs de los mags filtrados
writeLines(as.character(df_filtrado[["Bin Id"]]), here ("data","IDs_MAGS_filtrados.txt"))
```
